subject: Trading
title: Market Hours and Global Flow
description: One-minute skill: Market Hours and Global Flow.

hook.text: When New York closes, Tokyo opens. When Tokyo closes, London takes over. Money never sleeps.

buildup.text: Stock exchanges have fixed hours, but forex and crypto markets trade around the clock.

discovery.text: The overlap between London and New York sessions—8 AM to noon ET—is the most liquid window in finance.

twist.text: After-hours stock trading exists but has thin volume, wider spreads, and higher volatility.

climax.text: Global markets form one continuous chain. Events in Asia ripple into Europe and then America.

punchline.text: The market is always open somewhere.

quiz.question: When is the most liquid trading window?
